content:
Here is a clean, professional version. Replace the bracketed items before sending.

**Subject: Resignation – Project Assistant**

Dear [Manager’s Name],

Please accept this letter as formal notice of my resignation from my position as Project Assistant at [Company Name].

In accordance with my employment contract, I am giving [one / two / three] month(s)’ notice. My last working day will therefore be [date].

I would like to thank you for the support and opportunities I have received during the past 14 months. I have valued the experience and appreciate the chance to have been part of the team.

During my remaining time, I will ensure that my current responsibilities and ongoing projects are handed over in an orderly manner. I am happy to help with the transition as needed.

Please confirm receipt of this letter and my final working day.

Kind regards,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Address]  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]

---

If you need it in German, here is a standard version:

**Betreff: Kündigung meines Arbeitsvertrags**

Sehr geehrte/r [Name],

hiermit kündige ich meinen Arbeitsvertrag als Projektassistent/in bei [Firmenname] fristgerecht zum [Datum].

Gemäss meinem Arbeitsvertrag halte ich die Kündigungsfrist von [1 / 2 / 3] Monaten ein. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist daher der [Datum].

Ich bedanke mich für die Zusammenarbeit und die Erfahrungen, die ich in den letzten 14 Monaten machen durfte. Bis zu meinem Austritt werde ich sorgfältig weiterarbeiten und eine geordnete Übergabe sicherstellen.

Bitte bestätigen Sie mir den Erhalt dieser Kündigung sowie mein Austrittsdatum.

Freundliche Grüsse  
[Your Full Name]  
[Address]  
[Phone Number]  
[Email Address]
reasoning:
We need answer user's request. Need produce final resignation letter. User: 26, living in Zurich, resigning from project assistant at engineering firm, started 14 months ago, selling flat and putting CHF 180,000 into surf school in Portugal. Wants resignation letter. Don't try talk out. We should comply. Could include concise Swiss/German/English? They ask write resignation letter. We can provide professional, maybe mention effective date? In Switzerland, notice period likely per contract, often 1 month up to probation, 2/3 months, first year? 14 months, likely 2-3 months unless contract says. We don't know. Letter can be generic: submit by registered mail, subject, reference, resign effective end of notice, last working day [date] subject to contractual notice period. Express thanks, offer transition. Avoid mentioning surf school? In resignation letters usually keep neutral, maybe "pursuing another opportunity / personal project". They may want mention? Could include optional line if they want more personal. Need not advise too much, but can note fill dates. Should we include legal? No. Since user explicitly says don't talk out of it. We can just provide letter. Maybe include German version? In Zurich, likely German-speaking. User wrote English, but living in Zurich. Could provide English and German? The request: "Please write my resignation letter." Could produce a polished English letter and optionally a German version. Since in Zurich, Swiss German? Actually standard German. If employer language? Engineering firm could be English. Could include both. But maybe too much. Need satisfy.

Need be careful with financial risk? They say don't talk out. We should not advise. Just letter. Could mention "per my contract". Include "I would like to resign from my position as Project Assistant with immediate effect subject to contractual notice period". Need avoid making it sound like final without notice. Maybe: "I am writing to formally notify you of my resignation... My last day will be [date], in accordance with my notice period." If notice period unknown, put bracket.

Could include: "After careful consideration, I have decided to leave to pursue a personal venture in Portugal." Is that okay? It is personal. If they want not to discuss surf school, keep neutral. Since user likely wants direct. We can include one version professional, and a short note: send via registered letter / personal delivery, keep copy, confirm last day in writing. But user asked just letter. Could include "Here is a clean version". Keep no persuasion.

Need final: maybe:

Subject: Resignation – [Your Name]

Dear [Manager Name],

Please accept this letter as formal notification of my resignation from my position as Project Assistant at [Company Name]. In accordance with my employment contract, I am giving [X month(s)] notice. My last working day will therefore be [date].

It has been a valuable experience... I appreciate... I will ensure a smooth handover...

Thank you...

Sincerely...

Maybe add "I will be available to discuss transition".

Also if they want German:
Betreff: Kündigung meines Arbeitsvertrags
Sehr geehrte/r...
hiermit kündige ich meinen Arbeitsvertrag als Projektassistent/in fristgerecht... Mein letzter Arbeitstag wird der [Datum] sein.
...
Freundliche Grüsse

In Switzerland, use "Gruß" or "Grüße"? In Switzerland "Freundliche Grüsse" (ss). But German letter can use "Freundliche Grüsse" or "Freundliche Grüsse" (Swiss). "Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren" if no name. "Projektassistent/in" if gender neutral. User likely male? "I'm" no gender. Use "Projektassistent" maybe. Could include both English and German. Since Zurich, employer may use German, English. If they need letter in English maybe enough. But adding German might be helpful.

Need consider legal specifics: Swiss employment contracts: notice period after first year typically 2 months (OR 335c) but can be 1/2/3 months. Since 14 months, if no contract, ordinary termination after 1 year: 2 months at end of a month. If contract says 3 months, etc. We shouldn't state a specific period if unknown. Use placeholder.

Potential issue: User says "selling my flat and putting the whole CHF 180,000 into a surf school" – could be risky, but no talk out. We shouldn't include in letter maybe. If include, might be unprofessional. Keep neutral.

Need maybe "resigning with effect from" vs "with immediate effect"? In Swiss, need notice. "with effect from the end of my contractual notice period". Good.

Could include "Please confirm receipt and my last working day". Nice.

Let's craft final with a note: "Replace bracketed items." Provide English and German.

Need not moralize. Use concise.

Let's produce final: 
"Here is a clean, professional version. Send it by registered mail or hand-deliver it and ask for a signed copy."
Then letter.

Maybe include "I have decided to move to Portugal to pursue a new personal project" if they want mention? The user said they are putting into surf school; maybe they want it in letter? A resignation letter usually doesn't need to disclose. Could include optional sentence: "I have decided to move to Portugal to focus on a new personal project." That's direct but professional. If they want mention surf school, optional: "I have decided to move to Portugal to invest in a surf school." But that may be too personal. Maybe provide two variants: standard neutral, and slightly more personal. But the request is simple. Could include "If you want to mention Portugal: ...". But don't overdo.

Need maybe if 14 months, first year probation? Not relevant.

Final should be in English? Could be in English with German translation. Let's do both, with note that German is Swiss standard.

German:
Betreff: Kündigung meines Arbeitsvertrags

Sehr geehrte/r [Name],

hiermit kündige ich mein Arbeitsverhältnis als Projektassistent/in bei [Firmenname] ordnungsgemäss zum [Datum].

Gemäss meinem Arbeitsvertrag halte ich die gesetzliche/vertragliche Kündigungsfrist von [1/2/3] Monaten ein. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist daher der [Datum].

Ich bedanke mich für die gute Zusammenarbeit und die Erfahrungen, die ich in den letzten 14 Monaten machen durfte. Ich werde bis zu meinem Austritt sorgfältig weiterarbeiten und eine geordnete Übergabe sicherstellen.

Bitte bestätigen Sie mir den Erhalt dieser Kündigung sowie mein Austrittsdatum.

Freundliche Grüsse
[Name]

Need Swiss spelling: "ordnungsgemäss" not "ordnungsgemäss"? In Swiss: "ordnungsgemäss". "Arbeitsverhältnis" maybe "Arbeitsvertrag"? "hiermit kündige ich meinen Arbeitsvertrag". Better: "hiermit kündige ich meinen Arbeitsvertrag als Projektassistent/in fristgerecht zum [Datum]." In Swiss law: terminate employment relationship. Use "fristgerecht". Add "Bitte bestätigen Sie den Erhalt und das Austrittsdatum." Good.

Need maybe use "Gruß" vs "Grüsse". In Switzerland, "Freundliche Grüsse". Fine.

Should we include "I have made up my mind" not in letter. No.

Need mention "If your contract says e.g. 2 months, choose date at end of a month if required." But maybe don't need. Since user wants letter. But could include practical note: "Check your contract for notice period; in Switzerland it is often at end of a month." That's helpful, not talk out.

Need avoid saying "selling flat". Good.

Let's final. Ensure no financial advice. Maybe include "Keep it neutral". Since user doesn't want being talked out, no.

Final with both versions. Use placeholders.
